title: colorr: color palettes for sports teams — colorr-package
text: Palette functions, one per league:  epl.colors, soccer.colors, mlb.colors,  nba.colors, wnba.colors, nfl.colors  nhl.colors. colorr.colors job  league variable. find available, use colorr.leagues  colorr.teams. ggplot2, every league scale_colour_*, scale_color_*  scale_fill_* constructors, e.g. scale_fill_nba. built  colorr.pal, converts team palette palette function.
